notes.title: Berserk or Die patch 1.0.2 now live
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone - I'm pleased to say we have [b]another patch ready for Berserk or Die![/b][/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on making control schemes more flexible and easier to understand for new players, plus a few quality of life tweaks[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Added a drop-down menu in the option for selecting the preferred input method, so that the game doesn't switch input mid-gameplay, hopefully creating less confusion for players[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Tutorial stage, letting the player choose which input method to try out in the tutorial[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Updated the character selection input screen to showcase the selected input method and not everything at once[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added a Keyboard (simple) input mode, that's thought for people that have trouble with keyboard rollout issues (meaning they can't input more than X amount of keys simultaneously)[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Updated the bargain in the peddler to showcase the % chance of bargaining the prices and the resulting discount if said bargain is successful[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Added a visual indicator to the buckets/barrels projectile in the Samurai House stage[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the background elements in the Forest stage for better visibility[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Solved an issue where the Phalanx boss wouldn't be correctly defeated if certain specials were used[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of the Girl when playing the Demon of Discord, so that now she has an outline when hidden by foreground or background elements[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Solved an issue where wireless/bluetooth controllers weren't recognized properly[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Mouse and Keyboard / Keyboard only / Mouse only / Controller now have a "Simple" and a "Berserk" control scheme variant, one is for ease of play and one is for going full Berserk or Die![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]The training ground (tutorial stage) now has an input selection menu at the beginning of the stage, letting the player choose their preferred control scheme[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]When a controller is connected for the first time, a menu is opened, asking players to select between the "Simple" or "Berserk" control scheme for controller[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]There will be another patch following this one very soon, which will add even more flexibility to the game's control methods. In the meantime, check out our character breakdown video which gives tips and tricks on each character in the game![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="QbHlP-cRMQg;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Berserk or Die hotfix 1.0.1 now live
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We are gathered here today to remember and celebrate the [strike]lives of our neon gaming keyboards[/strike] launch of Nao Games' Berserk or Die![/p][p]It's been great to see such positive reception, watch people play even more unconventionally than expected, and read all the 3wapo3pfwjofwoj comments and reviews.[/p][p]We're also amazed to say we sold 10,000 copies of the game in the first 24 hours, so thank you so much for all your support since we launched last week![/p][p]
Huge thanks also directly from Shibata-san of Nao Games, who's very keen on listening to your feedback too:
"This time, we focused mainly on fixing bugs.[/p][p]We were only able to respond to requests to open a lot of loot, but next time we will respond to as many requests as possible."
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/ef48a90e402dabf584349a90965d122c86e28c49.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Hotfix now live[/h2][p]We've been listening to your feedback across Steam and poncle's social channels and have been working on new features, especially about alternative control schemes, but in the meantime we're also releasing  some quick fixes with patch 1.0.1:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed enemies getting stuck in Samurai Residence[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some bosses disappearing when left alone for too long[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes for characters occasionally getting stuck below the terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed boss defeat checkmarks[/p][/*][*][p]Added an Open All button in the Armory screen[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility in Forest stage[/p][/*][*][p]Revised wording for unlock conditions on the character selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Exiting a run will send you to the results screen now[/p][/*][*][p]Other minor fixes
    [/p][/*][/list][h2]Original soundtrack out now[/h2][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3732020/Berserk_or_Die_Soundtrack/?"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]You can now listen to all 16 tracks from Berserk or Die whenever you like, each composed by Filippo Vicarelli, a name you may recognise from poncle's own Vampire Survivors. There are 7 full BGM tracks from Berserk or Die, plus 9 Short tracks such as jingles, titles, and shop themes. We're also in the process of uploading the full soundtrack on Youtube:[/p][previewyoutube="si3_G-UBdLU;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Community items now available[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/000f159a53812766e83ffcfc7129056fef275c5a.png"][/img]Steam trading cards and community items are now available, we got the usual package of:[/p][list][*][p]4x profile backgrounds[/p][/*][*][p]6x badges[/p][/*][*][p]5x trading cards[/p][/*][*][p]11x emoticons[/p][/*][/list][p]You can learn more about Trading Cards [url="https://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/"]here[/url]
[/p][p][/p][h2]Coming in the next patch[/h2][p]From the next update you'll be able to switch control scheme easily, get a tutorial for these new schemes, and play with:[/p][olist][*][p]Default (Mouse + Keyboard)[/p][/*][*][p]Keyboard Only[/p][/*][*][p]Mouse Only[/p][/*][*][p]Gamepad[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all again and please stay tuned for more Berserk or Die updates very soon![/p]

notes.title: Berserk or Die is out now on Steam!
notes.content:
[b]I'm excited to say Berserk or Die (formally known as Last Standing) is out now on Steam![/b]

In Berserk or Die you play as a lone soldier fighting hordes of enemies on a burning battlefield - but really, the game is about the satisfaction of landing a perfectly-timed hit thanks to its unique control scheme where the more keys you press, the more powerful your attacks become.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2874130/Berserk_or_Die/ I created this game with the goal of making something completely new. I believe it offers an experience that no other game can provide. Not only have I been able to bring my unique ideas to life, but I've also had the pleasure of meeting some amazing people along the way.

You can watch our launch trailer here:

[previewyoutube=MddYxr07bfc;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Game Features[/b]
[list]
[*] Fight against hordes of enemies as the last soldier standing on battlefields from both history and fantasy

[*] Strike your keyboard left and right to attack; the more keys you strike, the wilder and more powerful your moves

[*] The keyboard is used not just as a controller, but as an extension of the player's movements, allowing them to face off against multiple enemies with their own hands

[*] Once your special gauge is full, shake your mouse to use your special move and wipe through the enemies on screen in one dramatic move

[*] Browse the wares of peddlers at nightfall, buying magical items to heal and power up

[*] Visit the training grounds to learn powerful new skills that transform you into a force to be reckoned with

[*] Experience all of the action in a unique pixel art style synonymous with the game’s creator, Nao Shibata

[*] Original soundtrack by Vampire Survivors composer, Filippo Vicarelli

[*] Accessibility options available for controls, in addition to the main keyboard and mouse setup
[/list]
I'd like to thank Luca and everyone at poncle for their support in making this game, and I can't wait for you to try it

[url=https://discord.gg/RpnG5Y5JKV][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44928665/0359fe7f208c3b4cf66806b78e3599bf8f9c61d6.png[/img][/url]

[b]Please visit [url=https://discord.gg/RpnG5Y5JKV]poncle's Discord server[/url] to talk more about the game and let me know what you think!
[/b]
- Shibata-san, Nao Games
